name: Scared Gorillas
summary: Scared Gorillas is a fast-paced fan game inspired by Gorilla Tag, where fear and speed collide. Play as a gorilla trying to survive in eerie maps full of shadows, surprises, and tension. Whether you're being chased or doing the chasing, every round brings a new kind of thrill. Run, climb, and escape the unknown in this spooky twist on the classic tag formula. Simple, fun, and just scary enough to keep you on your toes.
